rules.title: Section 232 tariff on advanced computing chips
rules.summary: A 25% tariff on certain advanced computing chips, including NVIDIA H200 and AMD MI325X class chips, when the import does not support the US technology buildout. Defined end uses are exempt.

model_effect.note: Applies to H200 and MI325X class chips unless exempt.

rules.title: Section 232 phase two: broader semiconductor tariffs
rules.summary: The proclamation allows broader, significant tariffs on chips, chipmaking equipment, and derived products after negotiations, paired with a tariff offset for firms investing in US production. Taiwan, Korea, and Japan have framework deals that may reduce exposure.

model_effect.note: Rate not set. Use the tariff slider to test values.

rules.title: BIS license review for H200 and MI325X class chips to China
rules.summary: Moves license review for H200 and MI325X class chips to China from presumption of denial to case by case, with a cap of 50% of US volume, third party testing in the US, and customer checks. Affects where chips can be sold more than what they cost.

model_effect.note: Changes sales volume to China, not unit cost.

rules.title: US export controls on advanced chipmaking equipment to China
rules.summary: Restricts sales of advanced lithography, deposition, etch, and inspection tools and their parts to China, with updates since 2022. Chinese tool makers have gained share in China as a result.

model_effect.note: Limits China's capacity; little direct effect on GPU unit cost.

rules.title: China ban on germanium exports to the US
rules.summary: China banned germanium exports to the United States in December 2024, after starting an export licensing program in 2023. China is the leading germanium producer.

model_effect.note: Indirect for GPUs. Price effect not yet sourced.

rules.title: China gallium export ban to the US lifted for one year
rules.summary: China lifted its ban on gallium exports to the United States for one year in November 2025, after export controls began in August 2023. China produced 99% of primary low purity gallium in 2025. Watch for renewal around November 2026.

model_effect.note: Mainly affects power chips and optics, outside the GPU package.

rules.title: China rare earth export controls (October 2025 expansion suspended)
rules.summary: China tightened rare earth export controls in April 2025, expanded them in October 2025, then suspended the October expansion for one year in November 2025. China produced about 69% of mined supply in 2025. Watch for renewal around November 2026.

model_effect.note: Reaches the GPU through polishing slurries and tool parts.

rules.title: China export controls on tungsten items
rules.summary: China added export controls on selected tungsten items in February 2025. China mined about 67,000 of 85,000 tonnes in 2025. Western tungsten prices roughly doubled during 2025.

model_effect.note: Price doubling, reported from USGS via a secondary source. Shows how small a mineral shock is at GPU level.
